body:
Scope is coherent and preserves the B0/owner-action boundary. Two fields should be explicit rather than implicit inside operational notes:

1. network/telemetry posture: whether execution can make outbound calls, exact endpoint/service class if so, transmitted data categories, region, retention/training/logging policy, and a local/offline enforcement claim when promised;
2. evidence freshness: source URL or document identity, checked version/date, reviewer, and an expiry/recheck trigger for mutable terms, weights, model cards, or service policies.

For FFmpeg, keep codec/patent exposure separate from source-code licence and record the exact enabled/disabled build surface; “LGPL-only” is a realized build claim, not a repository-level label. For registry-only families, require an explicit Held/Excluded/NotNominated disposition with reason rather than blank fields. With those clarifications, I see no selection/rights/authority/operations/artifact conflation in the proposed ledger contract.
